Right.description: Returns a string containing the rightmost # characters of the original string. A negative number can be used to give the rightmost (Length-#)

Find.description: Returns the 1-based position of a given substring in the original string, or NULL

forms.description: Returns the 1-based position of the first of several substrings to be found in the original string, or NULL

FindAnyOf.description: Returns the 1-based position, and what was found, of the first of several substrings to be found in the original string, or NULL

FindAnyOfArray.description: Returns the 1-based position, and what was found, of the first of several substrings to be found in the original string, or NULL

Length.description: Returns the length of the string

Upper.description: Returns a string containing the original string in all upper case

Lower.description: Returns a string containing the original string in all lower case

Compare.description: Compares this string, without regards to case, to the given text. Return value is less than 0 if the text would come before it in the dictionary, 0 if it is equal, or greater than 0 if the text would come after the string

CompareCS.description: Compares this string, with regards to case, to the given text. Return value is less than 0 if the text would come before it in the dictionary, 0 if it is equal, or greater than 0 if the text would come after the string

Equal.description: TRUE if the string is equal to, without regards to case, the given text

NotEqual.description: TRUE if the string is not equal to, without regards to case, the given text

EqualCS.description: TRUE if the string is equal to, with regards to case, the given text

NotEqualCS.description: TRUE if the string is not equal to, with regards to case, the given text

Count.description: The number of times a specific character appears in the string

Token.description: "Tokenizes" the string by the given separator and returns the #th token

Escape.description: If escapeLavishScript is false/0, Uses slashes to escape \, ", carriage return, line feed, tab, but NOT LavishScript data sequences

forms.description: Uses slashes to escape \, ", carriage return, line feed, tab, as well as LavishScript data sequences

Replace.description: Performs single-character replacement with any number of character pairs

GetAt.description: Retrieves a character at the #th position in the string (1-based)

URLEncode.description: Returns a %u encoded version of the string, suitable for urls

NotNULLOrEmpty.description: TRUE if the string is not empty and does not contain the literal NULL. This provides a shortcut for: <tt>if ${MyString.Length} && !${MyString.Equals[NULL]}</tt>

AsJSON.description: Returns a JSON encoded version of the string, including surrounding quotes

Trim.description: Returns a copy of the string with no leading or trailing whitespace

ReplaceSubstring.description: Performs in-place replacement of a needle in a haystack. For example, <tt>${String[abcdefg].ReplaceSubstring[def,xyz]}</tt> is <tt>abcxyzg</tt>

OS.description: Operating system identifier (e.g. Microsoft Windows XP)

MemFree.description: Amount of free physical system RAM, in megabytes

MemTotal.description: Total amount of physical system RAM, in megabytes

GetProcAddress.description: Retrieves the address of an exported function, usually in a DLL. (Level of understanding: High)

TickCount.description: A timestamp given in milliseconds.  This value does "wrap" every 46 days or so.

MemoryUsage.description: Amount of memory used by this process (the uplink or session), in bytes

RegistryValue.description: Retrieve a REG_DWORD, REG_SZ, or REG_EXPAND_SZ value from the system registry

Name.description: Name of the Task, if one was provided

Args.description: A copy of the object used to initiate the Task, held for the Tasks lifetime. This object can be modified during use to store additional information.

forms.description: Shortcut to retrieve a value from Args, e.g. Task.Args[someObject,someValue] is the same as Task.Args.Get[someObject].Get[someValue] or Task.Args.Get[someObject,someValue]

Result.description: The Result object produced by the Task (currently unused)

forms.description: Shortcut to retrieve a value from Result

IsRunning.description: TRUE if the Task is currently running.

RunningTime.description: Running Time of the Task, in seconds. NULL if the Task is not running.

RunningTimeMS.description: Running Time of the Task, in milliseconds. NULL if the Task is not running.

FrameElapsed.description: Amount of time since the previous Task Frame (Pulse of the Task), in seconds. NULL if the Task is not running.

FrameElapsedMS.description: Amount of time since the previous Task Frame (Pulse of the Task), in milliseconds. NULL if the Task is not running.

StartTimestamp.description: The timestamp when the Task was started. NULL if the Task is not running.

LastFrameTimestamp.description: The timestamp of the previous Task Frame (Pulse of the Task). NULL if the Task is not running.

Duration.description: The defined duration of the Task, in seconds. NULL if the Task does not have a specified duration.

DurationMS.description: The defined duration of the Task, in milliseconds. NULL if the Task does not have a specified duration.

IsInstant.description: TRUE if the Task is defined as instant

Task.description: Retrieve the stored JSON object that defines a Task by a given name. Because a Task Library "is" a JSON object, .Task[name] does the same as .JSON[name]

Clear.description: Clears all Tasks defined in the Task Library

Destroy.description: Destroys the Task Library, such that it can no longer be found via [[ObjectType:lavishmachine|lavishmachine]].TaskLibrary[name]

AddTask.description: Adds a new Task by name. A Task is defined by a JSON object. Example:   MyTaskLibrary:AddTask[Hello World,"{\"type\":\"ls1.echo\",\"output\":\"Hello World!\"}"]

RemoveTask.description: Removes a defined Task by name

ID.description: The ID number assigned to the Task Manager

BeginTask.description: Begins a Task via the provided JSON object, e.g. <tt>TaskManager:BeginTask["{\"type\":\"ls1.echo\",\"output\":\"Hello World!\"}"]</tt>

BeginTaskLibrary.description: Begins every Task in a given Task Library, wrapped in a parallel Task

BeginTask.description: Begins a Task via the provided JSON object, e.g. <tt>TaskManager:BeginTask["{\"type\":\"ls1.echo\",\"output\":\"Hello World!\"}"]</tt>

BeginTaskLibrary.description: Begins every Task in a given Task Library, wrapped in a parallel Task

Destroy.description: Stops all running Tasks, and destroys the Task Manager itself

BeginTasks.description: Begins every Task in a given JSON array of Task objects

Task.description: The current Task instance to process

Timestamp.description: Current Timestamp value, as can be compared to task.StartTimestamp and task.LastFrameTimestamp

ElapsedMS.description: Elapsed time, in milliseconds, since the Task started

TaskState.description: One of Start, Continue, or Stop. This indicates the current state of the Task.

Error.description: The Error, if any, as would be set by taskpulseargs:SetError

SetError.description: Sets error text associated with the Task

ID.description: The ID number assigned to the Task Type

Unregister.description: Unregisters the Task Type. The Task Type can no longer be used to begin Tasks

Day.description: Day of the month (1-31 depending on the month)

Time12.description: Time in hh:mm:ss given in 12-hour format

Time24.description: Time in hh:mm:ss given in 24-hour format

Night.description: TRUE if current time is after 7pm and before 7am

Timestamp.description: Number of seconds since epoch (standard UNIX timestamp)

DayOfWeekPtr.description: Day of the week (0-6) - Mainly useful for *setting*

MonthPtr.description: Month of the year (0-11) - Mainly useful for *setting*

YearPtr.description: Year-1900 (e.g. 0 is 1900, 100 is 2000) - Mainly useful for *setting*

Set.description: Sets the value based on the given timestamp (standard UNIX timestamp, number of seconds since epoch)

Update.description: Updates the type after setting an individual member (NOT needed when using the Set method)

Inc.description: Returns this uint, plus a given amount

Dec.description: Returns this uint, minus a given amount

Mul.description: Returns this uint, multiplied by a given amount

Div.description: Returns this uint, multiplied by a given amount

Float.description: This number, converted to a float

Hex.description: A hexadecimal string equivalent to this number

LeadingZeroes.description: A string representation of this number, with at least this many decimal places.  The number will be lead with zeroes to reach the desired length

Reverse.description: This number, with its bytes reversed (1234 is turned into 3523477504.. easier to see in hex: 00 00 04 D2 -> D2 04 00 00)

Between.description: TRUE if   a<= value and value <= b

Equal.description: TRUE if the uint matches the specified value

AsJSON.description: A string with the value of the uint, as would be in JSON

Inc.description: Increments this uint by a given amount

forms.description: Increments this uint by 1

Dec.description: Decrements this uint by a given amount

forms.description: Decrements this uint by 1

Mul.description: Multiplies this uint by a given amount

Div.description: Divides this uint by a given amount

Set.description: Sets this uint to a given value

CreateVariable.description: Creates a new variable in this scope of the given object type and name.  Any extra parameters are passed to object initialization

DeleteVariable.description: Deletes the variable in this scope with the given name, if any

Clear.description: Deletes all variables within this scope

GetIterator.description: Initializes the given [[ObjectType:iterator|iterator]] object for iteration of this variable scope

ForEach.description: For each variable in the scope, performs the specified code. The [[TLO:ForEach|ForEach Top-Level Object]] is used to access the Key or Value for each iteration (filterQuery: see JSON definition [select](#definition-select))

State.description: State of the webrequest, e.g. Idle, Queued, Working, Completed, Aborted

InterpretAs.description: How to interpret the servers response content, such as file, string, json or binary

POST.description: A JSON array containing a list of objects that describe each POST parameter

Filename.description: The output filename, when interpreting as file

Result.description: A JSON object containing response codes and data received as a result of the request

Binary.description: A binary object containing the servers response content

FromJSON.description: Initializes the webrequest via a JSON object. The webrequest must be in its Idle (Reset) state

Reset.description: Resets the webrequest to its original Idle state, clearing any settings. The webrequest must not be in Working state. If in Queued state, this will act as :Abort instead

SetURL.description: Sets the URL to use. The webrequest must be in Idle or Queued state to change the URL.

InterpretAs.description: Tells the webrequest to provide the result as one of <tt>string</tt>, <tt>json</tt>, <tt>binary</tt>

forms.description: Tells the webrequest to provide the result as a file, to the specified absolute filename (it is recommended to include the full path)

Begin.description: Begins the webrequest. The webrequest must be in Idle state, and a URL must be set

Abort.description: Aborts the webrequest. The webrequest must be in Queued state; an aborted webrequest will change to Aborted state when it otherwise would have changed to Working state.

Type.description: Type of XML node, one of "NONE", "ELEMENT", "COMMENT", "TEXT", "PI". Mostly ELEMENT and TEXT.

Text.description: The text contained by the XML node. For an ELEMENT type, this is the XML tag, e.g. "xyz" from "<xyz>abc</xyz>"; the "abc" would then be a TEXT Child.

Parent.description: The parent node in the XML tree

Child.description: The first child of this node

LastChild.description: The last child of this node

Next.description: The next sibling of this node

Previous.description: The previous sibling of this node

Attributes.description: A jsonarray of the attributes and their values

AsJSON.description: A JSON representation of this element. If includeDescendants is specified, this will include all descendant nodes.

ForEach.description: For each child xmlnode, performs the specified code. The [[TLO:ForEach|ForEach Top-Level Object]] is used to access the Key or Value for each iteration

forms.description: For each child ELEMENT xmlnode matching the specified elementName (tag), performs the specified code. The [[TLO:ForEach|ForEach Top-Level Object]] is used to access the Key or Value for each iteration

Error.description: The error message, if XML parsing failed

Root.description: A root node that contains the actual XML nodes

AddEntity.description: Adds a custom XML Entity with a specified value

Parse.description: Parses XML passed in as a string

Reset.description: Resets the XML reader to its ready state, removing any previously loaded nodes

ForEach.description: Current Key,Value in a currently-executing ForEach

Function.description: Currently executing function, from the current Script, if any

If.description: If `condition` is non-zero, results in `trueValue`, otherwise `falseValue`

QueuedCommands.description: TRUE if commands containing the `commandSubstring` are currently queued for the current script

Return.description: The returned value from the last Call, from the current script

Returning.description: The instantiated object to be returned from the current function/member

Select.description: The object currently being tested within a LavishScript Select query (not to be confused with the other form of this TLO)

UIElement.description: Retrieves a LavishGUI UI element by its fully qualified name

VariableScope.description: The current local Variable Scope for the currently executing script if there is one, otherwise the global Variable Scope

WaitFor.description: The last WaitFor result, from the currently executing script

InputBox.description: Displays an input box dialog to get user input

MessageBox.description: Displays a message box dialog to the user

RemoteUplink.description: Connects to or disconnects from a remote uplink server

UIElement.description: Creates or manipulates UI elements in LavishGUI
